selection_rationale: An eight-ship, all-1.5g fast-capital line that spends all 200 points: two heavily armored cruisers anchor the formation while six battlecruisers provide concentrated spinal-and-turret fire. The uniform speed preserves coordinated kiting or a synchronized close-range gun pass against unknown opposition.
formation_rationale: The Bastions form a forward, mutually supporting vanguard to absorb the first exchange. Lancers are staggered in lateral and vertical pairs behind them, preserving overlapping PD within roughly 100 km while spreading the fleet enough to complicate enemy spinal targeting; the rear pair serves as a reserve and flanking element.
